about.title: Purposeful Digital Creativity with Distinct Character
about.intro: Hello! I am Fantra, a Digital Creative & Visual Enthusiast dedicated to crafting compelling visual content, exploring digital media, and detail-oriented creative projects.
about.paragraph1: My creative focus spans visual storytelling, digital branding, interactive media, and content creation. I believe every visual piece should deliver a powerful message through balanced composition, precise typography, and profound aesthetic nuance.
about.paragraph2: With a strong background in digital business and creative technology exploration, I continually advance my capabilities across video production, visual curation, interface design, and adaptive digital media creation.

details.focusDesc: Visual content creation, digital branding, multimedia editing, motion graphics, and exploring modern digital platforms.
details.valuesDesc: Structured creativity, micro-detail precision, disciplined execution, and continuous learning aligned with global visual trends.
details.locationDesc: Based in Lampung, Indonesia — open for creative collaborations and forward-thinking digital projects.
